title: Whole Loans UK
summary: The /whole-loans/ page (search-result title 'Whole Loans UK') presents a whole loan as a single facility from one lender covering a developer's entire debt requirement, combining what would otherwise be senior plus mezzanine finance, usually secured by one first charge over the property. The lender may still split the loan internally into senior and junior tranches, but the structure avoids an intercreditor deed and a separate credit committee for each tranche. Silver Oak Capital says it works with a select group of private debt funds and specialist lenders who offer whole loans. No pricing, fees, rates, LTV/LTC/LTGDV limits, loan sizes, durations, eligibility criteria, process steps, FAQ items, testimonials or calls to action specific to this page were revealed by any of the three searches. Firm-level figures surfacing alongside are contradictory (300+ vs 800+ lenders; GBP 500k-20m vs GBP 2m-20m loan focus).
